The real estate agent is selling two homes right now: one that was owned by a Belgian family, and one that was owned by a Pakistani family. The agents needs to have both houses cleaned, but the Pakistani family's house needs more cleaning because it smells of food, while the Belgian family home will be a breeze to sell. Which home is easy to sell?
A. Not enough information
B. The Belgian family's home
C. The Pakistani family's home
